label_1.llm_guidance: LOAD-BEARING COPY: this is the visible label a reader uses to decide what number to type, and the arithmetic oracle asserts against it. Changing what it MEANS (not just its wording) silently changes what users believe the calculator computes. Reword for voice only; never change the quantity it names, its unit, or its currency marker.
